clock_model.rtl_boundary: clk_i rising edge advances one complete normalized E-cycle when clock_enable_i is high
clock_model.historical_boundary: HD6301V1 derives E from its oscillator; E is the documented peripheral and processor cycle reference
clock_model.limitation: This normalized boundary omits pin subphases; hd6301v1-four-subphase-device-bus separately implements every legal mode's digital bus waveform. Oscillator division, duty cycle, setup/hold, pad delays, and electrical timing remain outside both boundaries

signals.name: clk_i
signals.fact: one rising edge advances one normalized E-cycle

signals.name: clock_enable_i
signals.fact: active-high normalized-cycle enable; low preserves all synchronous digital state

signals.name: reset_n_i
signals.fact: active-low reset; latches the configured legal mode, uses the FPGA asynchronous CPU/peripheral boundary, and preserves the documented E-edge DDR clear

signals.name: standby_n_i
signals.fact: active low and sampled at an enabled E boundary; accepted standby resets active state, suppresses program reads and GPIO drive, and preserves RAM plus STBY_PWR while retention power remains valid

signals.name: nmi_n_i
signals.fact: active-low non-maskable interrupt whose falling edge is retained

signals.name: irq1_n_i
signals.fact: active-low maskable interrupt above internal timer and SCI sources

signals.name: standby_power_ok_i
signals.fact: digital integration indication only; it does not model an analog threshold

signals.name: port1_i
signals.fact: physical pin levels returned by PORT1 reads in modes where it is GPIO

signals.name: port1_o
signals.fact: latched GPIO output values except the lower address in Mode 1

signals.name: port1_oe_o
signals.fact: GPIO direction except all ones for the Mode-1 lower-address bus outside reset/standby

signals.name: port2_i
signals.fact: physical pin levels used by GPIO, timer capture, and SCI receive

signals.name: port2_o
signals.fact: GPIO latch with timer and SCI output overrides

signals.name: port2_oe_o
signals.fact: GPIO direction with timer and SCI overrides

signals.name: port3_i
signals.fact: physical or IS3-latched Mode-7 levels; normalized external reads instead use external_data_i

signals.name: port3_o
signals.fact: latched Mode-7 GPIO or the common block's documented expanded-bus value

signals.name: port3_oe_o
signals.fact: Mode-7 GPIO direction or expanded data-bus drive qualification

signals.name: port4_i
signals.fact: physical pin levels returned by PORT4 reads where that register exists

signals.name: port4_o
signals.fact: Mode-7 GPIO latch or mode-selected upper/partial address

signals.name: port4_oe_o
signals.fact: Mode-7 GPIO/partial-address direction or full-address enable

signals.name: is3_n_i
signals.fact: falling edge sets the P3CSR flag and captures Port 3 when latch enable is set

signals.name: os3_n_o
signals.fact: active-low during the selected Port 3 read or write E-cycle

signals.name: program_address_o
signals.fact: full CPU address, valid for the separately supplied F000-FFFF program image when program_read_o is high

signals.name: program_read_o
signals.fact: active for F000-FFFF reads in Modes 0/5/6/7 except the initial Mode-0 external reset-vector fetch

signals.name: program_data_i
signals.fact: FPGA firmware byte sampled for F000-FFFF reads, including all vectors

signals.name: external_address_o
signals.fact: normalized full sixteen-bit CPU address without half-cycle multiplexing

signals.name: external_data_o
signals.fact: normalized CPU write byte

signals.name: external_write_o
signals.fact: one denotes a CPU write; qualify it with external_bus_valid_o

signals.name: external_bus_valid_o
signals.fact: mode-selected normalized external transaction and always low in Mode 7

signals.name: external_opcode_fetch_o
signals.fact: qualified external read that fetches an opcode

signals.name: external_data_i
signals.fact: normalized external read byte

signals.name: sci_tx_o
signals.fact: normalized asynchronous transmit level when transmitter override is enabled

signals.name: sci_clock_o
signals.fact: normalized internal serial clock output for the selected supported mode

signals.name: timer_irq_o
signals.fact: diagnostic indication of an enabled input-capture, output-compare, or overflow flag

signals.name: sci_irq_o
signals.fact: diagnostic indication of an enabled SCI status request

halt_interrupt_behavior: HD6301V1 has no HALT input; SLP retains CPU state while peripherals run, an enabled request vectors, and a masked request resumes at the following instruction; E-sampled STBY enters reset-state operation and requires the selected mode's reset-vector restart on release

locators: HD6301V1 sections 2.1-2.4, 2.7, 2.9-2.13 and figures 5-3 to 5-6, printed pages 128-145, 156-167, and 189-190
